g.text: Cue — Job Execution and Failure Flow (FR-06, FR-07, FR-10, NFR-03)
Three independent triggers act on animation_job; every state change is a conditional UPDATE
Trigger
[W] Claim: UPDATE … WHERE id = (SELECT … status queued FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING
[DB] Commit at once, no transaction stays open while the GPU works
yes
A job was claimed and an active model_version exists?
no
[W] Sleep, poll again
[DB] Row is now running, locked_by, started_at, heartbeat_at and model_version_id are set
[W] Read both drawings from the media store
[DB] UPDATE status failed, error_code input_missing WHERE status running AND locked_by me
no
Both files readable?
yes
[W] Load the registered model_version, run generation (up to 16 frames), heartbeat runs independently
[W] Abort and discard all partial output
yes
Heartbeat UPDATE affected 0 rows?
no
0 rows means the job was already cancelled or reaped, nothing is overwritten
[DB] UPDATE status failed, error_code, error_message WHERE status running AND locked_by me
yes
Model error or out of memory?
no
[W] Set first and last frame to the input drawings (integrity check), pack the frames (ZIP), encode MP4
[MS] Write frames archive and MP4 (temp files, atomic rename)
[DB] BEGIN, INSERT media_asset (frames_archive, result_video), UPDATE status done (video, frames, frame_count) WHERE status running AND locked_by me
UPDATE affected exactly 1 row?
yes
no: cancelled or reaped meanwhile
[DB] COMMIT, job is done and the result is available
[SPA] S5 polling shows Done, "View result" opens S6
[DB] ROLLBACK, no video or frames row remains
[MS] Delete the just written frames archive and MP4
[MT] Find running jobs whose heartbeat_at is older than the threshold
[DB] UPDATE status failed, error_code worker_lost WHERE status running AND heartbeat stale
A late result from the "dead" worker fails its conditional UPDATE and is discarded
[SPA] S5 shows the failed state with a clear message, no automatic retry
[SPA] Confirm "Cancel generation"
[API] Check session and ownership
[DB] UPDATE status cancelled WHERE id AND owner_id AND status IN (queued, running)
Affected 1 row?
yes
no: already done, failed or cancelled
[API] 200, job is terminal; the worker notices at its next heartbeat
[API] 409 with the current status
A Job is queued: GPU worker loop
C User cancels
B Worker crashed or stalled: maintenance task
Box colour = layer: blue SPA, green API/maintenance (MT), amber DB or media store (MS), purple GPU worker (W).
Terminal states (done, failed, cancelled) are never updated again; each UPDATE is guarded by "WHERE status = expected".
Timestamps use clock_timestamp(), not now() (finding F-01).
